title: Degraded audit scored PASS by counting unrunnable checks as passes
code_snippet:
# go-licenses unavailable -> no-license mode. Auditor's scorecard:
# Standard: 4/5 PASS  (licence inventory: pass, escalation records: pass)
# Verdict: PASS
expected_feedback: The two licence items could not run, so they score N/A and leave both numerator and denominator: standard becomes 2/3 = 0.67, below the 0.80 threshold, and the verdict is FAIL. Counting an unrunnable check as a pass is exactly how a degraded audit reports success. See references/scorecard.md for the worked example.
